interpretation: ratio = observed within-game sign-changes / expected given each game's win total. ratio>1 (z>0) = more alternation than chance = ANTI-persistence; ratio<1 (z<0) = streakier than chance = momentum (the K&M positive-dependence direction). Conditioning on the game total isolates point-to-point dependence (D3) from block overdispersion (D4/D5), which a model-p-centered autocorrelation conflates.
